verdict.rationale: Vercel Workflows and the Workflow SDK are documented as running multi-step logic as durable code on a fully managed platform. That code can retry failed steps, wait for external events, and resume across crashes and deployments, which covers durable workflows-as-code with built-in retries. missing for 10: explicit documentation that no queue infrastructure needs manual setup, details on maximum workflow duration and long-running limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries

citations.quote: Vercel Workflows runs multi-step logic as durable code that can retry failed steps, wait for external events, and resume across crashes and deployments.
Build durable, observable applications and AI agents with the Workflow SDK on a fully managed platform.
